title: Extract method, extract class
summary: The two workhorse refactorings: name a block, and give a cluster of fields and methods its own class.

steps.title: Extract method, safely
body: 1. Pick a block that does one thing. Name what it does (not how).
2. Find the variables it **reads** from outside: those become parameters.
3. Find the variables it **changes** that are used afterwards: those become the return value.
4. Move the block into the new method, call it, run the tests.
foreach (var l in lines) total += l.Qty * l.Price;

steps.prompt: You extract the lines that compute `subtotal` from a block that also uses `taxRate` (read) and assigns `subtotal` (used later). What does the new method look like?
options: `decimal Subtotal(List<Line> lines)` returning the value, called as `var subtotal = Subtotal(lines);`
steps.explain: The block only reads `lines`, so that is the parameter. `taxRate` is not used in it. It produces one value, so return it.

lines: Make sure tests cover the current behaviour
If they fail, undo that one change

steps.title: Extract class
body: When a class has a group of fields that are always used together, and methods that only touch those fields, that group wants to be its own class.
public string Street, City, Postcode;              // a clump
Extract `Address` (fields + `Format` + `IsLocal`), and `Employee` gets one `Address` field. Each class now has one reason to change, and `Address` can be reused by `Customer` and `Supplier`.

steps.prompt: Complete the extracted class and its use.
code: record Address(string Street, string City, string Postcode)
var e = new Employee("Ada", new Address("1 Main St", "Leeds", "LS1"));
record Address(string Street, string City, string Postcode)

steps.title: Extract the methods
prompt: `Grade` mixes three jobs. Extract, keeping results identical:
- `double WeightedAverage(int coursework, int exam)`: 40% coursework, 60% exam
- `string Letter(double score)`: A from 70, B from 60, C from 50, otherwise F
- `string Grade(int coursework, int exam)` returns e.g. `68.4 B`, using the two methods
solution: double WeightedAverage(int coursework, int exam) => coursework * CourseworkWeight + exam * ExamWeight;

steps.title: Extract the class
prompt: `Order` carries a clump of shipping fields. Extract them:
- `record ShippingAddress(string Name, string Street, string City)` with `string Label()` returning three lines joined by `\n`: name, street, city in upper case
- `class Order(int id, ShippingAddress shipTo)` with `string PackingSlip()` returning `Order <id>` then a newline then the label
`Order` must not have `Street` or `City` of its own.
starter: class Order(int id, string name, string street, string city)
solution: record ShippingAddress(string Name, string Street, string City)
template: var dojoAddr = new ShippingAddress("Ada", "1 Main St", "Leeds");

Dojo.Eq("PackingSlip", "Order 7
Ada
1 Main St
LEEDS", new Order(7, dojoAddr).PackingSlip());

forbid.message: Order has no street or city of its own
